value.rationale: The natural question of uniformly generating a growing finite-algebra direct power has a sharp three-source obstruction transition. The result classifies the entire birthday-scale zero/positive phase boundary, identifies the unique triple-critical parameter family and its independent Poisson means, and proves universality across all higher nilpotent structures of the local factors. This is substantive asymptotic structural information rather than a restatement of a finite generation criterion.
